name: IUCN Red List
notes: The species' Red List assessment: status, trend, habitats (IUCN classification), systems, elevation, generation length, threats, and its habitat and ecology text. First choice for every fact it covers.

name: IUCN range map
notes: The species' IUCN range polygons, analyzed in PostGIS by this project: realms (OneEarth) and countries (Natural Earth) that hold a real share of the range.

name: IUCN SSC Tortoise and Freshwater Turtle Specialist Group
notes: Species accounts in Conservation Biology of Freshwater Turtles and Tortoises: size, diet, breeding, clutch size, lifespan.

name: AmphibiaWeb
notes: Species accounts written or reviewed by amphibian scientists (University of California, Berkeley): size, calls, breeding, life history.

name: Amphibian Species of the World
notes: American Museum of Natural History: amphibian taxonomy and distribution.

name: The Reptile Database
notes: Reptile taxonomy, size and distribution, with citations to the literature.

name: Animal Diversity Web
notes: University of Michigan Museum of Zoology species accounts with cited sources: mass, lifespan, diet, activity, breeding.

name: Mammal Diversity Database
notes: American Society of Mammalogists: mammal taxonomy.

name: Peer-reviewed study
notes: A published scientific paper; the source URL is its DOI or journal page.

name: Smithsonian's National Zoo and Conservation Biology Institute
notes: Animal fact sheets from zoo scientists and keepers.

name: San Diego Zoo Wildlife Alliance Library
Government wildlife agency
notes: National wildlife agencies (US Fish and Wildlife Service, Parks Canada, Australian Government and others) and their recovery plans.

name: Conservation organization
notes: Major conservation groups working with the species (WWF, WCS, Fauna & Flora and others).

name: Encyclopaedia Britannica
notes: Edited encyclopedia articles, often by specialists.

name: Wikipedia
notes: Only for a fact the higher tiers don't cover, checked against the article's own cited source.

name: News report
notes: A major news organization reporting a finding or event; only when the higher tiers don't cover it.
